## TentativeVerificationQuery type

Query a [ICredentialProvider](./credential-w3c.icredentialprovider.md) if a verification attempt can be made using the provided document

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type TentativeVerificationQuery = {
  document: W3CVerifiableCredential | W3CVerifiablePresentation
}
```
